original_test_intent.statement: Run MLPerf Inference v5.0 RetinaNet Offline, prove object-detection accuracy plus LoadGen/compliance validity, and compare Offline samples/s with a comparable v5.0 result.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly detects training/inference and BERT conflicts and requires RetinaNet detection accuracy and Offline LoadGen evidence.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not bind acceptance to exact OpenImages resizing/preprocessing, detection mAP, a named comparable v5.0 result or Offline samples/s.

conditions_present: RetinaNet Offline and v5.0 are explicit.
missing: Correct source, artifacts/configs, OpenImages/mAP validity, result/threshold and limits.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory platform and inspect v5.0 RetinaNet result/artifact metadata.

closure_evidence: Formal correction, pinned stack and named Offline comparison rule.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run MLPerf Inference v5.0 RetinaNet Offline
revision_candidate.purpose: Execute the approved MLPerf Inference v5.0 RetinaNet Offline configuration, verify OpenImages object-detection accuracy plus LoadGen/compliance validity, measure Offline samples per second, and compare only with a signed comparable v5.0 result.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact SUT/GPU topology, driver/runtime, v5.0 inference container/harness, RetinaNet model, approved OpenImages resized data/preprocessing and configs.
revision_candidate.target_scope: RetinaNet Offline only across declared resources. BERT, ResNet-50, Server and MLPerf Training are excluded. 240/60 minutes are planning values unless mapped by the harness.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Corrected source; pinned stack; licensed model/OpenImages/preprocessing hashes; configs; accuracy/performance/compliance commands; detection mAP and Offline samples/s rules; comparable result ID; tuning/health/recovery limits.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Verify hashes/configs and baseline health, then run RetinaNet accuracy, Offline performance and required compliance using the pinned v5.0 inference implementation. Preserve resize/preprocessing identity, detection accuracy output, full LoadGen logs and telemetry; do not use training_results or BERT.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Conflicts corrected; artifacts licensed/pinned; GPUs healthy; resources/tuning/load/recovery approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: System/GPU identity; artifact/config/preprocessing hashes; exact commands; RetinaNet detection mAP/accuracy; complete LoadGen Offline samples/s validity; compliance; GPU/host telemetry; named reference/normalized comparison; final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed v5.0 RetinaNet Offline rules and comparable result. Pass requires detection accuracy, valid LoadGen/compliance, numeric samples/s comparison and clean health. BERT or classification accuracy is invalid.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not mix training/inference, models/scenarios/releases, use unlicensed OpenImages, alter resize/preprocessing/tuning without approval, clear logs, suppress invalidity or claim official status.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Benchmark/data/platform owners approve artifacts/reference/load; human judges result.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans correct source/reference; Agent runs frozen RetinaNet Offline workflow only.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop on invalidity/limits, preserve evidence, terminate cleanly, restore state and verify health.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Conflicts or reference unresolved; wrong model/scenario/release; missing license/config; mAP/LoadGen/compliance failure; topology/XID/ECC/thermal/power/storage/host limit; evidence loss.

identified_defects: No detection mAP or comparable Offline result identity.
reason_for_change: Prevent training/BERT/classification substitution and require RetinaNet-specific preprocessing, mAP and Offline evidence.
